event.distribution_pattern: distributed in CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IA, IN, NH, NY, PA, SC, TX, WA, and WI.

products.product_description: Bulletproof Unflavored Collagen Protein High Performance Building Blocks Dietary Supplement, packaged in a 16-oz. composite-film bag, UPC: 8 15709 02115 3. The label is read in parts: "***COLLAGEN PROTEIN***Ingredients: Hydrolyzed collagen powder***Processed in a facility that also processes tree nuts, peanuts, egg, soy, milk, wheat, fish, crustacean shellfish***Manufactured in USA for: BULLETPROOF 360, INC. Bellevue, WA 98004***".
products.code_info: Lot #1017088 EXP03/19. EXP03/19 means expires by March 2019.
products.reason_for_recall: Bulletproof Collagen Protein is recalled due to undeclared milk. The actual product inside the package is whey (milk) protein but mis-labeled as collagen protein.
